name: How long does artificial turf installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does artificial turf installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of artificial turf installation can vary based on the project's size and complexity. For an average-sized residential yard, the installation typically takes between one to three days from start to finish. Larger or more intricate projects, such as those involving extensive grading, custom shapes, or multiple distinct areas, may require additional time. We provide a projected timeline during the initial consultation and strive to complete every project efficiently while maintaining our high standards of quality. Factors like weather conditions can also influence the schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Artificial turf installation for an average residential yard usually takes 1-3 days, though larger or more complex projects may require more time.
